text:
miguel: Heads-up — we're seeing elevated KMS egress latency from GCP eu-central (europe-west3). A subset of GPU attach requests are timing out and triggering node eviction retries. Graphs: https://grafana.redwood/board/edge?panel=kms-egress-latency :grimacing:
neha: On it. Is this network egress to Google KMS or our managed HSM?
miguel: Looks like Google-managed KMS endpoints (kms.googleapis.com) — p95 has doubled, p99 spiking to 3s in the last 6m. A few pods returned `deadline exceeded` during mount, which caused the attach controller to retry and hit device throttles.
oncall: I've paged infra oncall. tagging @chris.
chris: ACK. Pulling logs from the attach controller now.
chris: `kubectl -n infra logs attach-controller-7b9f | tail -n 50` shows repeated `context deadline exceeded` and `failed to unwrap key` errors.
infra-bot: [alert] gpu-provisioning-errors increased 4x in last 10m (severity: warn).
sam: Repro: ran a manual attach against a warm pool instance — attach succeeded but decrypt took ~2.6s. Not consistent but correlates with eu-central egress spikes.
neha: Two immediate mitigation options: 1) shift new traffic away from europe-west3 to europe-west1 (eu-west1) until GCP fixes; 2) enable our KMS local keycache fallback (will accept slightly older cache entries for ephemeral inference keys for ~5m). What do we prefer?
miguel: We should evict as little as possible. Preference: traffic shift + enable cache for attachments that hit >1s. Also open a ticket with GCP networking ops.
oncall: I'll run the routing flip for inference read-only traffic first. Not doing full production until we confirm attach stability.
chris: Routing change enacted: `routeset set --policy region-preference --from europe-west3 --to europe-west1 --match inference-read` — monitoring.
deploy-bot: route-change: user=oncall action=apply routeset_id=eu-fallback-2026-03-18 status=ok
neha: Enabling KMS local keycache with degradation policy (ttl=300s, allow-stale=true for attach-only). Patch applied to attach-controller.
sam: After both, attach failures dropped to baseline. p99 decrypt latency back to ~600ms. GPU warm pools stable.
miguel: Good. Cost note: routing to eu-west1 increases egress and infra cross-region delta — expect ~12% short-term increase. Filed billing alert.
chris: Opening follow-up runbook item: add automated detection -> routing + cache enable playbook (ticket INFRA-4821). Also logging to capture KMS request IDs for GCP support.
oncall: I'll keep this thread updated. If GCP confirms a regional networking degradation we'll revert traffic when they are green. :thumbsup:
miguel: Thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated for now, keeping monitoring on for 1h.
